text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reaching the midpoint of the Classic
Year, 
Cheval Grand arrived at Summer Training 
Camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Concerned about Kitasan Black, who had 
been feeling down since the Japanese 
Derby,
they looked for her on the bus ride 
there, but she was nowhere to be found...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the glamorous sisters arrived 
at the training camp in their private
car. Bringing a massive amount of luggage,
they 
were fully prepared to enjoy the summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand brought her own fishing rod 
and was all set to take a breather,
but... 
all in all, the long summer training camp 
is about to begin!
